Kihyun Han is a Ph.D. candidate in Statistics at Pennsylvania State University, advised by Yanyuan Ma. He received his B.S. in Mathematical Sciences and Statistics (double major) from Seoul National University in 2022.
His research develops semiparametric and nonparametric methods for inference when a covariate is right-censored, with applications to Huntington disease studies. He also works on robust inference and predictive inference under distribution shift.
